overview_description.description: Speed is a leading Bitcoin payment processor for businesses and individuals to easily accept Bitcoin payments. They provide instant transactions and ensure all the transactions are secure protecting merchants and customers from any fraudulent attempt. Customers can choose to pay via any on-chain or lightning network, Speed is compatible with more than 100 wallets. With its user-friendly interface, integration with various shopping carts, and support for multiple languages, Speed makes it easy for merchants of all sizes to start accepting Bitcoin payments.

product.name: Online Payments
product.description: A platform enabling businesses to accept Bitcoin and stablecoin payments online via checkout pages, payment links, and plugins.

product.name: In-person Payments
product.description: Solutions for accepting Bitcoin and stablecoin payments offline using QR codes, wallet apps, and POS integrations.

product.name: Send Payments and Payouts
product.description: Services to send Bitcoin and stablecoin payments, including payouts, refunds, and withdrawal links.

product.name: Developer APIs and Integration Tools
product.description: APIs, SDKs, and libraries enabling developers to integrate Speed's Bitcoin and stablecoin payment processing into applications and platforms.

product.name: Invoicing
product.description: A crypto invoicing tool to create, send, and manage Bitcoin and stablecoin invoices with automated reminders and branding customization.

product.name: Cashback
product.description: A cashback program that rewards customers with Bitcoin on payments, using QR codes for easy redemption.
